## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* Southern-Sòng compilation by **Shízhī Zōngxiǎo** 石芝宗曉 (1151–1214) of materials documenting the **Bǎoyúnsì** 寶雲寺 Tiāntái lineage — the institutional centre under **Bǎoyún Yìtōng** 寶雲義通 ([義通](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E9%80%9A), 927–988) at which Sìmíng Zhīlǐ received his Tiāntái formation. Companion to Yuánwù's parallel *Luóxī zhènzǔ jí* ([KR6d0223](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0223)).

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed within Zōngxiǎo's productive period c. 1180–1214.
